name: Benton County, AR
findings: Benton County has 700 nonprofit organizations. 270 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 205 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Benton County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.
